prompts.npc_mara_design: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: character design reference for Dig to the Core Roblox expansion, npc_mara. One full-body recognizable classic BLOCKY Roblox NPC Mara the Lifeguard, squared torso, rectangular limbs, simple round cylinder head, warm tan skin, dark brown hair in a compact bun, coral lifeguard jacket with cream collar and cream sleeve stripe, navy shorts, cream shoes, navy whistle cord and chunky gold whistle. Calm amused simple smiling face. Neutral three-quarter front standing pose, one hand raised in welcoming gesture. No realistic anatomy, no fingers, no bacon hair (reserved for player marketing mascot). Saturated flatter colorful YouTube-thumbnail illustration, thick near-black outlines, two-tone cel shading, restrained details. Palette coral #ff5f7d navy #1d2a44 cream #fffae8 turquoise #28bef5. Entire character inside canvas with padding, no props beyond whistle, no text, no floor, transparent background. This is concept design, not a gameplay screenshot.
prompts.npc_pip_design: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-body Roblox character design reference npc_pip for Dig to the Core. Entire character framed with padding, transparent background, no text, no floor, no realistic anatomy, no fingers, no bacon hair. Faithful to an achievable Roblox primitive model.
